United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO)

title.narrative: In the context of the intersectoral program “Learning for diversity: strengthening synergies between culture and education for inclusive, sustainable and resilient societies”, in collaboration with the Education Sector, provide capacity support to heritage and educational institutions for the integration of culture into educational curricula and tools to transmit ICH.

description.narrative: Capacity building workshop targeting the culture, education, science and other relevant sectors will be organized on devising a strategy to integrate intangible cultural heritage into educational pedagogy with the aim of safeguarding, promoting and transmitting to the younger generation. The workshop discusses and recommend a strategy to identify, inventory and document the living heritage, knowledge and practices to integrate in formal and informal education for its contribution for peace, nature conservation, gender equality, socioeconomic development, etc In response to the request from the Ethiopian Heritage Authority, capacity building workshop on the preparation of nomination to diversify ICH domains the country will register. It will be organized in collaboration with UNESCO Nairobi Regional office.
